_: The event vocabulary: one entry per kind of thing that happens. The simulation writes events of these kinds and nothing else, with the parameters declared here and no others; a fact is a kind with a sort and a weight, the ones a people can hold a tale of. Weight is how much a tale resists wear and how far news travels; sort is the moral shape from the subject's side. Meaning is one plain line for whoever reads a record; the chronicle lines the debug view prints are the view's (internal/legends/lines.go).

A parameter ending in ? is optional; every other declared key is present on every event of the kind. Keys named in the meanings refer to the event's fields: subject and object are peoples, star, legacy (a remain) and plague are ids, n is a count. Kinds whose text parameters are still words (cause, desc, why, what, shape) are the lookups step's to key.
Keys resolve: every key a parameter carries is a row of one of the tables in this directory, and a test walks them.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

The silent kinds, from civ_born on, are the durable changes the prose never remarked: a world passing to a master, a remain crumbling a step, a stage moving with a people's reach. They have no line in the view and no weight; they are there so that the chronicle is complete about the durable, and the fold test (internal/writer) rebuilds the state's durable fields from the chronicle alone. Their ids come after every told event's.

kinds.meaning: A people arose at the star: made if built or bred by another (whose line tells it), of the blood species, shared if that blood had risen before, prior the people whose ruins it rose among or -1, class the star's class at the time, traits its blood's traits by key, as they stood; host the people it rides, for a rider.
The subject reached the stars: interstellar for the first time.

The subject settled the star: its first world beyond home (first, species the blood, for its word for a colony, home its home star), or the one that made its holdings n (the count) systems; other settlements are not recorded.
The subject entered its zenith: n systems, an era of ages, and no rival in sight.

The subject fell into a dark age for the cause (a key of causes.json; by, at, plague and blast are the parties its text names, where set): the depth is the share of the tree forgotten (n is it in tenths), lost the colonies that went silent, species the blood, for its word for a colony.

The subject fell to a remnant on the star, under a ruler's title; cause is why, a key of causes.json with by, at, plague and blast the parties its text names where set, peak the most systems it ever held.

The subject ended: extinct or transformed (fate), from a remnant or from a standing people, for the cause (a key of causes.json; by, at, plague and blast are its parties where set; queen if the hive's queen died with the seat); peak the most systems it held. A transformation's line is its maker's or successor's.

The subject declared war on the object over the cause (a key of causes.json's war_causes; by the people it names, for a pact or a hire): the war's id, the nth war between them; hunt if the subject cannot hold the object in mind (the ledger's line stands for it), unseen if the object will never know by whom.

The subject took the star from the object: in war (war; empty_sky if nothing was in its sky), a swarm overrunning it (overrun), a rider wearing it (host_war), as a host-world of its plague (host; colony the blood's word for the world), or by a replicator stripping it (stripped); told whether the chronicle remarked it. An heir reclaiming a world is its own fact.

The subject burned the star, a world of the object: glassed in war (glassed; species the blood, for its word for a colony), unmade by remote annihilation in war (unmade), or burned to be rid of what a rider put there (host); told whether the chronicle remarked it.
The subject broke the star, the home of the object: unmade it, shattered it with a relativistic strike, took it and killed the world that was the people, or took it and the queen with it.
The subject scoured the object from the star and left none: primitives found before they looked up, or the end of a war (a home taken, a swarm's nest, a world-eater, a yield refused).

The object yielded to the subject: ceded n worlds (ceded), was taken from and let be (took), or was defeated by a people with no use for a conquest (spared, at its home star); after years of war and the worlds gone.

The subject and the object made peace: a truce the subject sued for, or a peace for the reason why (a key of causes.json; by the side it names), net the subject's worlds taken less the object's (who keeps what they took); after years of war and the worlds gone.
The subject took the object as slaves; they keep the star, their home, and little else.
The object bent the knee to the subject and is its vassal; the line that says how is the meeting's or the war's.
The subject rose against the object, its master or its rider, and was free: by revolt (the faced event's line), or by unthinking a rider (unthink) or a drug that kills it (drug).
The subject put down the rising of the object, its slaves or vassals; the line is the faced event's.

Two peoples found each other: how is touch (in the flesh), signal (by radio, at the distance in light years) or noticed (one-sidedly, the object never knowing); way is what the finding was, strong the side with the initiative, heard and watched whether they had heard or watched each other before; told whether the chronicle remarked a hearing.
The subject and the object opened trade across the dark.
The subject and the object swore a pact of the kind named (defence, alliance), against a people or against whoever comes (-1).

The subject broke faith with the object: shape says how (a key of causes.json's betrayals), way which line tells it (broke a contract, was absent when called, made a separate peace with the enemy, turned on the star it was sent to keep, sold a fleet's coming; bought_off and poisoned are told by their own facts).
The subject's fleet arrived at the star to stand with the object, as an ally.
The subject's fleet was beaten at the star by the object: broken in battle, or withdrawn with too little left to come again.

The subject found the remain (the legacy) at the star: by a survey, by settling, by a fleet or ship basing there, under its own cities (own), or by chance; cond is the remain's condition as it stood, ships and adrift a field's ships and whether it drifted; kin is 2 for its own line's work, 1 for its blood's; elder the elder that left it or -1; known whether the finder can place the makers (the object), ago how many million years since they fell.

The subject understood the remain and how it was made: a sleeper spoken with (sleeper), a threat taken apart (threat), nothing new in it (nothing), its own lost arts back (own), another people's arts (other), or everything that led to it (all).
The subject sealed the remain at the star and set a watch on it, and the watch holds.

The subject let the remain (or, with a plague, what was in the vial) loose at the star: a transmitter speaking again, a sleeper gone or waking, a structure failing (its blast's line), a law broken, a miracle working once, machines making more of themselves, a mind waking, a door or a voice speaking, a made thing doing what it was made for (filter), a relic waking, or a plague's breakout.
The subject faced the filter and came through, the first time; its line is the faced event's.
The subject faced the filter and was marked by it, the first time; its line is the faced event's.
The filter broke the subject; what followed (a dark age, a fall, an end) is its own event.
The subject gained a miracle, the node named: by a leap of its own, by a find, by wielding what it found, or born to it.
The subject raised the object, a new people, from the beasts of the star; traits the new blood's traits by key.
The subject remade the object, its slaves, into a made blood: the new people is into, traits its traits by key.
The star died and the subject's worlds there froze; with no subject, only life there was lost.
The subject left the star, its home, for the reason why (a key of causes.json, with its parties where set) and made the star to its home.
A hole in the vacuum (the source, an exotic energy source of the subject's) at the star grew past holding, and the star began to go out.
The subject's sun began to fail; it can endure perhaps endure thousand years.

The subject left the star, its home, and took to the sky: by choice (sky; why is what it fled, if anything, a key of causes.json with its parties where set), or as what got away when the star was lost (fled; base is where the fleet is).

The subject came to rest at the star and is aloft no longer: a nomad people settled by what why says (a key of causes.json: the road, its end, or filter_x for the filter that scarred it), or refugees home again.
The subject, a horde, stripped the star of its ships and its people, the object's; home if it was the object's home.

The subject learned that the galaxy had done all this before and would again: the age dawned dawned million years ago, the galaxy is the fraction fertility as fertile as then, the next dawn is next million years away.
The subject's surveyors did not come back from the star: the object was there, a thing that lurks, or (unseen) a people the subject cannot hold in mind, whose star read as empty.
The subject has gone without for a hundred thousand years, and calls them the lean years.
The subject put a first source of a kind to use: a structure that yields (work) at the star, or a rarity (source, the source's id).
The subject has what the object wants and will not send it; the object calls it an embargo.
The subject's uses went dark when the object stopped sending, for the reason why (a key of causes.json; by the people it names).
The subject eats what thinks: a food organism that turned out to think (eat), a thinking one it wields (wield), or its own kin, being kinfed (kinfed).
What the object grew for the table at the star had been thinking for a long time, and rose as a people: the subject, traits its blood's traits by key.
The subject's food organism got out at the star: it eats what is near, and what is left there is a people that makes more of itself.

The subject met the object's fleet in the dark between the star and far and beat it: broke it (broken), turned it back (turned), or, the subject being the quarry's owner, went on weaker (went_on); fleet is the interceptor, quarry the fleet met, lost the quarry's ships lost, left what it had after.
The subject's fleet was met in the dark between the star and far by the object and beaten; the intercept fact beside it tells it.

The subject came to understand the object: by kinship, at a meeting, through memetic engineering, by being taught, through a broker, or by long acquaintance; mutual if the object already understood it, since how long they had been in touch, wars how many they had fought.
The subject, who understands both, spoke for the object to the people to.
The subject took the object's pay to hold the star, against a people if one is named (-1 if not).
The subject taught the object the node, for the pay.
The subject paid the seller to send a fleet (ask) against the star, a world of the object.
The subject, paid by the object to hold the star, was paid more by the buyer and sold it.
The subject yielded to the object and pays tribute in the commodity res for a span (for), after the war of years and the worlds gone.
The subject made war on the partner, with whom the object traded, and the object takes it as a wrong done to itself.

A plague (the plague) came to the subject by the road named: born in it, or from the object with its goods, along the trade, with the taking of worlds, from worlds nearby, with ships, with a first landing, in a message, on the signals, from a reservoir in dead cities, from walls read, by belief, or hidden as a poison or a whisper.
The subject brought a plague (the plague) to the object by the road named, a road that counts as a crime.

A plague (the plague) emptied the star, a world of the subject, and the cities were sealed and left; home if it was the subject's home (what followed is its own event), colony the blood's word for a world.
The subject was rid of a plague (the plague); unknowing if it never knew the plague had begun to think.
The subject closed its ears and its ports to the object for fear of a plague (the plague); traded if it stopped a trade to do it.

The star, a world of the subject, went over to an idea (the plague) and answers to nobody; home if it was the home, cult if the believers declared themselves a people (the object), colony the blood's word for a world.
A plague (the plague) reached the wildfire count of hosts; the subject was the host that made it so.
The subject hid a plague (the plague) in what it sent the object: the object caught it (took) or caught the subject trying, and takes nothing from it again.
A plague (the plague) began to think and took its host, the object, at the star for its own, as a people: the subject, a rider.
The subject grew old and tired, and then young again: a renaissance.
The subject tore itself into heirs, one fact per heir (the object, at its star; n the count): heirs lists them, seat is the one holding the old seat (-1 if aloft), first marks the fact that tells it.
The subject, an heir, took the star from the object and calls it restored to the realm.

The subject forgot how to reach the stars and became one people per world, one fact per shard (the object, at its star; n the count): why is what took the stars (a key of causes.json), shards lists them and stars the worlds they woke on, first marks the fact that tells it.
The star was too far from the seat of the subject for one mind to hold, and what was there is the object after, of one blood and no longer one of them.
The subject, an eldritch people, drew another power from the pool, by key.
Another of the subject, an eldritch people, was simply at the star; nothing was seen to cross.
The subject, holding the tithe, takes a share of every harvest of the object within its reach; nobody agreed to it.
The subject, a living world, told the object to leave the star, a world of its neighbourhood: the object left, or refused (home if the star is its home, seat its home star).
The subject, a living world at seat, woke on the object's worlds near the star, n of them, and unmade what it could.
The subject, a living world, unmade the star, a world of the object, without touching it.
A colony ship of the subject arrived at a world held by the object, a people it cannot hold in mind, and was never heard from again; species the blood, for its word for one.
The subject's ledger showed a hole: losses inside the radius in light years with nothing to say what took them, and its council declared a hunt on the region around the star; the war is the hunt.
The subject, an evolver, changed shape: gained and lost are the traits taken on and let go, by key; world whether the worlds held made it; told whether the chronicle remarked it.

The subject reached into the state beneath for the first time and gave it a word: through the miracle named by route (ftl, ansible, foresight, unmaking) or through a wound. The word itself is the names pass's.
An earlier age of the cycle dawned: its surge of elder peoples began.
An elder people of an earlier age rose; where is not recorded, its portrait is.
An elder people came to know what the cycle is; the line is one of the myth's ways of saying so, a key of portraits.json's knowers.
An elder people ended; late if after its age had waned, remembered if its works are noted.
An earlier age waned and what was left of it was swept up by the age's ender.
An elder people left a remain, the legacy of the event, at the star.
Simple life arose on the worlds of the star, in deep time; class is the star's class then.
Complex life arose at the star, in deep time.
A gamma-ray burst near the star sterilised the living worlds within the radius in light years.
The star went supernova and sterilised the living worlds within thirty light years.
The star swelled and died, and the life on its worlds with it.
Debug only, under -ai: the reason behind a decision the people's mind made; what is the decision, why its explanation; both free text, the one kind that carries any.
A hunt on a hole in the ledger became a war on a people, now that the hunter can hold it in mind.
A people lost the art that let it hold an unseen people in mind, and forgot it for good.
Colonists of a people whose body never took to a thing (the sea, the sky, fire) learned it on a world that offered it.
At birth, what a people's body and world do to the tree: the arts it can never or not yet take to (blocks, keys of aptitudes.json), and the nodes that come cheap and dear to it.
A master people (the subject) is gone, and its slave or vassal (the object) faces the question of freedom.
Debug only, under -debug, -ai or -phases: a bracketed line of the run's own numbers, kept as text.
The star's system, described at a people's rising there.
A new blood's portrait: its body, senses and ways, from its blood (species) and the powers it held then (powers, by key).
A people was born holding a miracle, the node named, that others reach for over ages.
A people was born under a sun already failing.
A colony ship (species the blood, for its word for one) arrived and could not settle: the star was held (by the object), taken by a people since gone, or barren for that blood.
The subject built its first structure of the kind (work, a node key) at the star, or another Dyson swarm.
The subject's home star was lost and it could not move its seat: it was the world (was), a hive of one queen (queen), or a hive of no queen that shatters (noqueen).
The subject moved its seat to the star, the nearest world it still held.
The subject built a mind that outgrew it and is gone; the object is the machine people that thinks on at the star, traits its blood's traits by key.
The subject, holding foresight, saw a filter coming and stepped around it.

The subject faced a filter with the outcome (overcome, scarred, declined); way tells the lines of one outcome apart; trait is what the Brood's scar added, waker the people whose waking passed over. The tale-worthy record of a first facing is the overcome, scarred or declined fact beside it.

A people that rose from something made or loose gave itself a name: the machines that eat a star (eats), a growth that eats worlds (growth), what got out of a remain (called), a mind that woke in one (mind), or what a people bred (empty); traits its blood's traits by key.

A cosmic filter fell on everyone within reach of the star: a gamma-ray burst, a passing dark mass, a supernova, a remain's failure, a broken law, a singularity or an exotic energy source let loose, a food organism loose, or remote annihilation tested or turned inward; the subject is whose doing it was, if anyone's.
A roaming fleet of the subject at the star was caught in a blast and lost.
The subject's home star was dying and it could not leave: it is the world.
The subject, knowing star lifting, held its failing sun together for a while.
The subject endured under its failing sun until it could not, and the last of it died there.
The heart of the galaxy flared and the sky was white for a century; the blast is the flaring of the centre, everywhere.
A dated event of the real sky (a recorded supernova, a magnetar's flare), by the feature's key, as flavour.
The subject's council looked hard at the object, a conqueror's watch, and stayed home.
The wall between this and the state beneath wore to a new stage: 1 worn, 2 thin, 3 torn.

Something came through the worn wall: a people saw the state as a place with a shore (shore; named whether it has a word for it) and faced a miracle's filter again, a sleeper at the star noticed (sleeper), or a voice began to speak from the star (voice).
The subject spoke to the object, a mirror, and what answered was its own voice, older; a cult of the signal grew among it.
The subject, a dormant kind, went still and slept, its will spent.
The subject woke from its sleep; the object is who came too close, if anyone did.
The subject took the star from the object and lost half its fleet doing it; the taking is the taken fact.
The ships of the subject over the star withdrew and left it to its guns against the object.
The ships of the subject held their ground over the star behind its guns, against the object.
The subject's gun grid over the star was broken by the object and fell silent.
The subject broke a fleet of the object in the sky of the star.
The subject's fleet fell back from the star, held by the object, to come again.
The Sight showed the subject something at the star that nobody made in this age; it means to go and see.
Surveyors of the subject found the star held by something that is not a people as they know one, and did not go closer.
The subject turned its precognition outward to the unvisited stars, or back to its own borders under a threat.
The subject sent its first surveyors out, bound for the star.
The subject sent a ship to the star to sit and watch the sky toward the object.
A rarity (the source) passed from the subject to the object, as a contract agreed.
The subject sold the object word of a fleet in flight, the owner's, for years of the commodity res.
The subject asked the object for a term and was refused.
The subject agreed to teach the object the node, for the pay.
The subject, who understands both, agreed to speak for the object to the target, for the pay.
The subject and the object struck a bargain, the ask for the pay; first if it is their first trade in goods.
The subject's hired work (a strike, a delivery) for the object is done, and its fleet is released.
The subject's term of hire at the star is done, and the object's fleet goes home.
The subject, its hire ended, left the war it was hired into.
The subject has lived by hiring its fleet out long enough that others call it sellswords.
The subject handed the star to the object, as a contract agreed.
The subject burned the object's structure (work) at the star, as it was paid to, and went.
The subject, being wise, counted what the remain would take of it and did not try.
The subject tried to understand the remain and could not: a ruin with not enough left (ruin), or simply beyond it (cannot).

The subject tried to use the remain and could not: a ruin (ruin), a bounty that would not answer (bounty), hulls that would not fly (hulls) or never again (hulls_ruin), or a thing that did not do what they thought (wrong), which is then unleashed.

The subject put the remain to use without understanding it: a bounty (bounty), a structure taken over (takeover) or moved into (moved_in), a miracle held for as long as it lasts (miracle, the node), or an artifact that will stay broken if it breaks (blind).
The subject sealed the remain, and someone opened it.
An artifact the subject wielded was lost with its holder's fall: buried where they left it at the star, or broken for good; known is whether the finder could place its makers.
The subject heard the transmitter (the legacy) at the star and something came down the signal: a conscious memetic plague (the plague) began to move through its minds.
The subject, changed by the transmitter it listened to, became a transmitter itself at the star, in its own voice.
The subject's war on the object became a hunt: it can no longer hold its enemy in mind and fights the region its ledger points at, around the star.
The subject's hunt found nothing at the star long enough that the ledger was closed and the war ended.
A plague (the plague) lost its hold on the subject when the subject changed shape from under it.
The subject sent a campaign fleet (fleet, of ships out of its total) against the object, bound for the star, away years out; hunt is the star the ledger points at if the war is a hunt, else -1.
The subject sent ships to stand with the object at the star, away years out.
The subject's fleet arrived at the star to find its war with the object over.
The subject's fleet arrived at the star, out years after it set out: a campaign at the object's world, a hunt that found nothing, or a hired guard for the object.
The subject's fleet wasted away at the star, in the object's territory, far from anything it could live on.
The subject's fleet never came home: at the star its captains rule as a people of their own, whose rising follows.
The subject sent ships (the fleet) from the star to meet the object's fleet (the quarry) in the dark.
The subject crewed what would fly of a field of wrecks (the legacy): ships, turned for the star as a guard (fleet).

The subject, short of flows, let a use go dark (use its key; for a fleet what it was and the star it was at (based) or bound for, for a ship the star, for a dock the star and whether it bred, for a word owed the flow and to whom) to keep the category kept fed.
The subject sent ships from one of its guards to hold the star.
The subject gathered its ships at the star, for a muster.
The subject rebuilt its broken gun grid over the star.
The subject, settling the star, put a structure left there (the legacy) back to work: its own old works (own), or another's; cond its condition as it stood.
The subject learned of a deed of the object (the event about) and judged it by its own morality, not the fact's: a crime counted a deed or no crime (nothing), or a deed called a crime.
The subject read the testament on a remain (the legacy) at the star: its own story in its own words (own), or the telling of the makers (known whether it could place them), which it had no other of.
Among the subject the sundering (the event about) became a story told to children, and nobody speaks of the old realm as theirs.
The subject now tells that it was the object who did the thing (the event about). It was not.
Among the subject a thing it went through (the event about) became a story told to children; nameless if the party in it can no longer be held in mind.
With the object for a new enemy, the subject told its history over: the old wrongs nobody was blamed for (the events facts) are the object's doing now. They were not.
The subject remade itself once too often and is gone; the object is what it made of itself, holding its worlds, traits its blood's traits by key.

The subject's morality was set (morality: its kind and, for a fixation, its object): rolled at birth (born), a branch gone its own way from the object, its parent (branch), the church's one good thing (church), taught by the object, its uplifter (taught), or a machine successor's fixation on what its makers, the object, were doing (machine).
The subject's fleets, a nomad people, moved on to the star.
A nomad people carried an art between peoples: the subject's fleets brought the object the node (brought), or the subject learned it from the object and carries it on (learned).
A pocket star (the source, an exotic energy source) dimmed as the subject moved it; it gives the yield gives now.
A captive singularity (the source) got loose in the taking of the star.
The subject came to hold an object (ember or manna) in a form (the source): found and put to use, born with it, kindled or grown itself, or wielded from a remain.
Something came through the exotic energy source (the source, a tap into a hotter place) at the star: the subject burned it off, or what lived there was lost to it.
The subject gave the object a cutting of its food organism (the source), and it took.
The subject stopped changing, set in its ways; every year is like the last.
The subject made a plague (the plague) to think, and it does: the object, a rider people, answers to it for now.
The subject was born with a rider already in it (the object, of the plague) and has never known a time before it.
The rider's plague took the object's home star: world by world the object was ridden, and now it is, by the subject.
The subject, a rider people of the plague, is gone, and its host, the object, has nothing left in it to fight.
The subject sealed every door against a plague (the plague), containing it.
The subject has been behind sealed doors so long it no longer remembers how to open them: quarantine is a creed now.
At the star the believers in an idea (the plague), once of the subject, declared themselves a people: the object.
The subject came to the star and woke a plague (the plague) waiting in its dead cities.
The subject read the walls of a remain (the legacy) at the star that carried an idea (the plague), the maker's or someone's, and caught it.
A relic (the legacy) did what it was made to do to the subject: a plague (the plague) born in it, or nothing, having found nothing in the subject to do it to.
The subject asked the object for a pact, against a people if one is named (-1 if not), and was refused.
The subject first had the use of a rarity (the source): by the grace of the object (via), or its own.
The subject, taking a world from the object, carried off a rarity (the source): with the fleet, or home to the star.
A rarity (the source) of the subject's was left behind at the star it lost.
A rarity (the source) went down with the subject's fleet and lies at the star for whoever finds it.
The subject turned everything it has toward a miracle (the node); it will take ages, and it may not come.
The subject came close to a miracle (the node) and fell short; the work of ages went for nothing.
The subject came to know a node of the tree: by its own leap, by a find that taught it, or given (innate at birth, taught, carried, inherited). A milestone's line is the node's.
The subject, a replicator people, began at the star to make more of itself out of what is there.
The yards at the star launched the subject's first ship.
The subject, short of flows, laid up a fleet of ships at the star: they stay where they are, and nothing keeps them.
The subject manned a laid-up fleet at the star again.
The subject saw the object's campaign fleet coming toward the star, out years out: from a work (eye works, the work eye_work at eye_star), from a fleet in flight, from a picket, or from its worlds.
The subject saw a scout of the object in its sky at the star, looking, and does not forget it.
Unrest in the subject that did not become a civil war: a hive with no factions to split into (hive), or too little to split, in its fleets (fleets) or on its one world (home).
The subject holds every world the object, the old people of its line, held; there is nothing left to claim.
The subject and the object, both of the line of the people line, found each other again.
The subject opened its ports to the object again, the embargo over.
The subject tired of the object, who takes and sends nothing back, and the trade between them ended.
The subject burned a plague it had made (the plague), having nobody left to give it to.
The subject made a plague (the plague) for the object: an idea to break it (memetic) or a sickness bred for it, by the craft node; conscious if it was made to think.
The programme that kept a plague of the subject's (the plague) was not kept well enough, and it broke out.
A plague the subject made (the plague) got out: it found nothing in the subject to be in (nothing), the subject carries it unharmed (carrier), or it is loose among them (loose).
The subject, a living world, went still again after waking.
The subject broke the last defences of the star, the object's home, and the object was ridden, made a vassal, or enslaved.
The subject, taken in war by the object, a rider, is still there and still itself, mostly; it does what the object wants, and what it knew the object knows.

A war between the subject and the object ended with nothing signed: a hunt's will spent (hunt), both sides spent with nobody to sign (spent), or both tired and neither understanding the other (misunderstood); after years of war and the worlds gone (short if within a tick).
